name: MIA-Bench
intro: MIA-Bench是一个新的基准，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）严格遵循复杂指令的能力。该基准包含400个图像-提示对，每个都旨在挑战模型在生成满足特定请求模式的准确响应时对分层指令的遵循。评估结果显示了最先进的MLLM在性能上存在显著差异，突出了指令遵循方面的改进空间。
build_method: 人工分层提示编写, GPT-4V内容标注, GPT-4o逐组件评测
metric: 指令遵循总分与八类分项分数（0至100）
build_method_en: Manual layered-prompt authoring, GPT-4V content labeling, GPT-4o component-wise evaluation
intro_en: MIA-Bench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to strictly follow complex instructions. It contains 400 image-prompt pairs, each intended to challenge models in generating accurate responses that meet specific request patterns while adhering to hierarchical instructions. Evaluation results reveal significant performance gaps among state-of-the-art MLLMs, highlighting room for improvement in instruction following.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01509, Sections 2, 2.1, and 2.2. The diagrams preserve all four image sources, GPT-4V content labeling, manual layered-prompt authoring, the correctness/no-leakage/image-dependence gates, all eight sub-instruction types, five collection-time complexity levels, per-component weights from 1 to 10 summing to 10, the exact 400-pair release, and GPT-4o component-wise scoring aggregated to category and total scores. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.
